sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Red Dial Bracelet Watch for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elevate your style with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a rich red dial, classic Roman numeral detailing and a sleek flexible gold-tone bracelet strap. The deep red dial beautifully contrasts with the polished golden finish, creating a sophisticated vintage-inspired look.
Its slim oval dial and elegant ribbed bracelet give it a refined, jewellery-like appearance, making it perfect for women who prefer a classic yet stylish timepiece. Easy to pair with both ethnic and western outfits, this watch adds a graceful touch to any look.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired bracelet watch
- 💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
- ❤️ Elegant deep red dial
- 🕰️ Classic Roman numeral detailing
- 🔗 Sleek flexible ribbed bracelet strap
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 💎 Jewellery-inspired elegant design
- 👗 Perfect for ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Ideal gifting option for women
- ✨ Suitable for everyday wear and special occasions
Perfect For
Office wear, college, casual outings, festive occasions, parties, date nights, weddings and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
